fact.en: Mistaking the Nandas for Kshatriyas; Puranic sources clearly label them as 'Sarvakshatrantaka' (destroyers of Kshatriyas) and Shudra origin.

fact.en: Assuming Alexander defeated the Nandas; historical evidence suggests the Nanda army's strength was the reason Alexander's soldiers refused to move further east.
